tagline: Fuji取景器相机，1983 年发布
description: Fuji于1983年推出的取景器相机。配备Fujinon 38 mm f/4, 3 elements/3 groups.。快门速度1/100 (ISO 100), 1/300 (ISO 400).。感光度100 or 400, switching between the two preset shutter speeds.。3-zone focusing.。

specs.感光度: 100 or 400, switching between the two preset shutter speeds.
specs.英文简介: A zone focusing compact camera from Fuji, released in 1983.
